answer: Each epoch the protocol posts A, how many answers it has already accepted, and the next submit burns (A+1) units of this epoch's per-head payout, locked to that key and struck at close. Passage at the wharf costs 1 for the first key and 10 for the tenth, since nine already rest above the nadir of the accepted stack. A farm of n pays the triangle n(A0+n+1)/2; a fresh key cannot reset A, split the burn, or pre-age it, because A only rises and parallel posts are serialized in inclusion order. Refuse the burn and that quill is dropped.
